// Fixture: every line below MUST be flagged.
package example

import "os"

func write() {
	_ = os.WriteFile("note.md", nil, 0o644)
	_, _ = os.Create("note.md")
	_, _ = os.OpenFile("note.md", os.O_RDWR, 0o644)
	_ = os.Remove("note.md")
	_ = os.Rename("a.md", "b.md")
	_ = os.MkdirAll("dir", 0o755)
}
